That matters because the company credits the step up to the generative AI platform, and the platform kept winning customers this quarter. A margin that falls while revenue grows suggests the new work is mostly services, or that platform costs are rising. What to watch: fourth-quarter gross margin against this quarter's 31.2%. A third decline would mean the mix shift management credits has stopped lifting BigBear.
